mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS trend falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or average 20-day return in declining rate periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 9.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in >40% of UNRATE >9.0% instances or average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer credit demand (RSAFS) indicates weakening housing and consumer sectors, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in >60% of cases or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Post-recovery expansion regime (INDPRO growth >0.5% monthly) indicates accelerating manufacturing output that boosts corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >50% of INDPRO growth >0.5% periods or average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS trend falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or average 20-day return in growth periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in >40% of CPIAUCSL YoY >2.5% instances or average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in manufacturing output (INDPRO) and rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates contractionary monetary policy coinciding with supply-side weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint INDPRO decline and FEDFUNDS rise fails to predict negative 60-day returns in >60% of cases or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Early-cycle expansion regime (RSAFS growth >1.0% monthly) indicates expanding consumer credit demand that fuels retail sales and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >50% of RSAFS growth >1.0% periods or average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
